mechanics_text: Detonates like a mine when used, punches like a nuke, and stings like an EMP bomb.
Supernova DLC. Deploys at ship location and immediately detonates in a 40000m sphere.
Range 0 and Speed 0 — deploys at user position, no projectile.
version_notes: Supernova DLC. Unique weapon — deploys at ship position (range 0, speed 0). Both physical (140) and EMP (80) damage in 40000m AoE.
